tasks.subject: Task 1: Backend - batch recently-failed executions into JobState
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Add recentlyFailedExecutions to the generated JobStateResponseDto, replace the per-job N+1 query with one batched query, remove the now-unused single-job endpoint.

**Files:**
- Modify: libs/maia-job-parent/maia-job-spec/src/main/kotlin/org/maiaframework/job/spec/MaiaJobSpec.kt
- Regenerate: libs/maia-job-parent/maia-job-domain/src/generated/kotlin/main/org/maiaframework/job/JobStateResponseDto.kt
- Modify: libs/maia-job-parent/maia-job/src/main/kotlin/org/maiaframework/job/JobExecutionRepo.kt
- Modify: libs/maia-job-parent/maia-job/src/main/kotlin/org/maiaframework/job/MaiaJobService.kt
- Modify: libs/maia-job-parent/maia-job-web/src/main/kotlin/org/maiaframework/job/MaiaJobEndpoint.kt

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] JobStateResponseDto has recentlyFailedExecutions field (generated)
- [ ] getAllJobsCurrentState batches the query and truncates to 10 per job
- [ ] JobExecutionRepo.recentFailedExecutions takes Iterable<JobName>, uses `in`, bounded PageRequest.of(0,200,sort)
- [ ] /job/recently_failed/{jobName} endpoint deleted
- [ ] Compiles

**Verify:** `./gradlew :libs:maia-job-parent:maia-job-domain:maiaGeneration :libs:maia-job-parent:maia-job:compileKotlin :libs:maia-job-parent:maia-job-web:compileKotlin` (from repo root) -> BUILD SUCCESSFUL; confirm generated constructor order is (description, jobName, recentlyFailedExecutions, runningJobs)

tasks.subject: Task 3: JobsDashboardStore with polling
tasks.description:
**Goal:** NgRx signal store wiring pure functions to fetched job data, with 15s polling split from manual retry.

**Files:**
- Create: libs/maia-ui-workspace/projects/maia-jobs/src/lib/jobs-dashboard/state/jobs-dashboard-store.ts

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] State: jobStates, isLoading, error, nameFilter, now
- [ ] Computed: visibleJobStates, statusCounts, countSummary
- [ ] startPolling() fetches immediately then every 15s forever
- [ ] retryFetch() is independent one-shot fetch, doesn't reset polling timer
- [ ] No distinctUntilChanged anywhere
- [ ] onNameFilterChanged patches directly, no debounce

**Verify:** `npx ng build maia-jobs` (from libs/maia-ui-workspace/) - builds with no TypeScript errors

```json:metadata
{"files": ["libs/maia-ui-workspace/projects/maia-jobs/src/lib/jobs-dashboard/state/jobs-dashboard-store.ts"], "verifyCommand": "npx ng build maia-jobs", "acceptanceCriteria": ["state and computed signals correct", "startPolling perpetual timer", "retryFetch independent of timer", "no distinctUntilChanged"], "requiresUserVerification": false}
```
